payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over possible scream times for Rick within a limit (1000 steps), marks them, then checks Morty's times. Uses pre-check with gcd to detect impossibility.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively searches a bounded time range after an impossibility check, which resembles backtracking only in being a complete search, but lacks recursion/backtracking. Among given subtypes, backtracking is the closest match.
